content: आरोहणम् .²1 The act of rising, ascending, mounting; आरोहणार्थं नवयौवनेन कामस्य सोपानमिव प्रयुक्तम् <ls>Ku. 1. 39</ls>. .²2 Riding (on a horse <ab>&c.</ab>). .²3 A stair-case, ladder; अथारोहणमासाद्य वेदिकान्तरमाश्रितः <ls>Rām. 5. 10. 13</ls>. .²4 The rising or growing of new shoots, growing (of plants). .²5 A raised stage for dancing. .²6 A carriage (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
